The attendee journey

From the listing to the gate.

Planifya keeps the event and its digital ticket connected, so you can review what you bought and present the correct QR at entry.

Discover the event

Browse public event listings and review the organizer, location, timings and available ticket tiers.

Choose your ticket

Select a tier and quantity, check the sales cutoff and attendee requirements, then review the order before payment.

Open My Tickets

Your issued e-ticket stays linked to your Planifya account with the event and ticket details.

Present the QR

Show the QR credential at the gate. The organizer scans it to confirm the ticket’s current entry status.

Your ticket record

More useful than a screenshot.

The ticket in your account carries its current Planifya status. That matters when a credential has already been used, an event changes, or support needs to trace the order.

QR

Ready for entry

Open the ticket from My Tickets and present the QR associated with that purchase.

✓

Checked at the gate

Organizer scanning helps distinguish a valid ticket from one already used or otherwise unavailable.

ID

Traceable for support

Keep the event, order and transaction details available if a payment or ticket issue needs review.

For organizers

Publish, sell and verify entry.

Approved providers can create ticketed events subject to Planifya’s event verification. Set the event details and ticket tiers, track sales, and use the built-in scanner at entry.

  • Ticketed event creation from the provider account
  • Tier, price, capacity and sales-cutoff controls
  • QR scanning with ticket-status feedback
  • 2% commission deducted from organizer ticket-sale proceeds
The first 500 approved vendors pay no vendor subscription fee. Transaction commission still applies.
Read the vendor guideTicketing rules
Before you buy

Read the event, not just the headline.

Review the venue, date, timings, ticket tier, capacity, sales cutoff, attendee requirements and event-specific terms before confirming an order.

Ticket changes and refunds

Tickets are generally final for buyer change of mind unless the event terms, a Planifya exception or applicable law provides otherwise. Event cancellation or material changes are handled under the ticketing and refund rules.

Protect your account

Do not share your password, OTP, PIN, CVV or unrelated payment credentials. Only present the ticket QR when entry verification is required.
